notes.craft: PDPs state the place of make for every item, with a stage-by-stage origin table. The Guatemala denim names its maker (The New Denim Project). The about-us page and the PDPs describe partner producers and co-ops; the brand claims no owned factory, in India or anywhere else, so this is named making without ownership, a 3.

cities: 5 stores — Brooklyn, Joshua Tree, New York, San Francisco, Venice, and its own site

vinted.n: No Vinted brand entry; keyword search in Men

craft_evidence.owned_d: Current site does not claim an owned factory anywhere, India included. About-us page: IOAN 'partners with trusted producers around the world'. Oxford shirt PDP refers to 'the IOAN team of partners in India', '3rd generation makers', not an IOAN-owned plant. The in-house work is only the free repair/re-dye service run by IOAN's own sewers at the LA HQ (5066 W Washington Blvd), which is not production.
craft_evidence.countries: India (Tamil Nadu) 3/6, Guatemala (Guatemala City) 2/6, Bolivia 1/6 (sample of 6 PDPs: jeans, oxford shirt, alpaca sweater, t-shirt, work jacket, chinos). Each PDP has a stage-by-stage origin table (raw material, processing, cut & sew, labels, tags).
